raw_read.name: Raw read (debug)
raw_read.description: Read a BLE characteristic and return raw and decrypted hex.

raw_write.name: Raw write (debug)
raw_write.description: Write hex bytes to a BLE characteristic. Can send any command to the machine: use with care.

data.name: Data
data.description: Hex bytes before encryption, e.g. 00 47 FF. With encryption, byte 0 is replaced by the key.

encrypt.name: Encrypt
encrypt.description: Encrypt with the machine key (default on).

record_start.name: Start recording (debug)
record_start.description: Keep the connection open and record every BLE frame, progress and status read every second.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Auto stop after this many seconds (10-3600, default 600).

record_stop.name: Stop recording (debug)
record_stop.description: Stop recording and save a JSONL file in the config folder.
